text.tspan: 2 · Admin side: one order moving between the lanes, from submitted to paid
Ekte Mat ordering system (to-be). Source: docs/requirements/basic_desc.txt. Status badges show where the order status changes.
Questions: at any time the customer can send a question about an order; the admin reads and answers it on the order page (diagram 1).

Lanes follow the case interviews: coordinator (Sunniva), kitchen (Mateo) and driver. Event-type minimum guests (example values; admin can set 1–265): corporate lunch 8 · birthday 10 · confirmation 15 · christmas party 20 · conference 30 · wedding 50.
